Type: narrow open shelving unit
Use: holding towels, baskets, plants or books; bathroom, hallway, bedroom
Style: traditional, farmhouse, rustic
Materials: solid pine with a black-brown stain, slatted bottom shelf

Goes with: white walls, white tiles, brass or black hardware, woven baskets; farmhouse, traditional or rustic bathrooms and hallways
